title: What If Naruto Read ONE More Line Of The Forbidden Scroll? — Part 1

NARRATOR.description: Warm, grounded, dramatic storyteller with a dry streak.

NARUTO.description: Loud, stubborn, hungry for acknowledgement. Goes quiet only when it matters.

CLONE.description: Naruto's voice, slightly brighter and faster. Bickering shadow clones.

KURAMA.description: Deep, slow, cavernous. Post FX echo.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Six days after graduating dead last, Naruto Uzumaki is sitting in the Hokage's archive with two hundred copies of himself.

visuals.query: Naruto surrounded by a crowd of identical Naruto clones in a cramped Hokage archive, scrolls everywhere
many Naruto clones sitting on the floor reading scrolls and documents

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They are reading every mission report the Hidden Leaf has filed in twenty years. And the Third Hokage is the one who ordered it.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage at his desk in the Hokage office, pipe in hand
towering stacks of mission reports and documents in the archive

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, this report just stops in the middle of a sentence. Is that normal?

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding up a mission report, puzzled, in the archive

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yeah. Read the next one.

visuals.query: Naruto with a quiet serious expression, unusually still

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It is not a power up. Every shadow clone that disperses sends what it learned back to the one who made it. Naruto is not told until he is sixteen.

visuals.query: shadow clones dispersing in puffs of smoke around Naruto
Kakashi explaining the shadow clone jutsu to Naruto

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: But that is years from now. Tonight he is twelve, filthy, alone in a forest, and he keeps reading.

visuals.query: Naruto kneeling in the dark forest, eyes on the scroll, a faint grin
Naruto small beneath a huge night sky

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Midnight, a forest clearing. Naruto has a hundred bruises and, at last, one perfect clone.

visuals.query: exhausted Naruto standing opposite one perfect clone in a moonlit forest clearing
moonlit forest clearing at night where Naruto trains with the scroll

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Okay! Look at that. It even has my stupid face.

visuals.query: Naruto grinning wide, dirty and scratched, in the forest

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: That is my stupid face! Boss, we did it!

visuals.query: Naruto clone grinning and pointing, forest night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They grin at each other. Then the clone steps back to celebrate, and the root behind him does not step back.

visuals.query: Naruto clone stumbling backward over a tree root
a gnarled tree root catching a heel in the dark forest

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa—

visuals.query: Naruto clone falling backward arms flailing

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Pop. And ten feet away, Naruto yelps and grabs his own knee. It is scraped raw.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone poofing into smoke
Naruto clutching his knee and yelping

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ow. Wait. I didn't fall.

visuals.query: Naruto wide eyed, looking down at his knee, shock

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Under the hand seals, in cramped brushwork, there is a note he was about to roll right past.

visuals.query: Naruto looking down at the open Scroll of Seals
the scroll with small handwritten text beneath hand seal diagrams

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The jutsu was invented by the Second Hokage, Tobirama, for scouting enemy ground. And he left a warning on the page.

visuals.query: the Second Hokage Tobirama Senju, white haired and stern
the forbidden scroll with an image of Tobirama

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: Created by Tobirama Senju for scouting.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The note reads. What the clone learns, the caster keeps. For this reason the technique is forbidden. The mind fails long before the chakra does.

visuals.query: close up of the handwritten warning under the clone jutsu on the forbidden scroll
Naruto's eyes moving across the page, firelight on his face

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: So everything he learns, I learn. Everything.

visuals.query: Naruto stunned, mouth slightly open, forest night

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A twelve year old with more chakra than anyone alive has just found the only cheat code in the shinobi world. Four years early.

visuals.query: Naruto standing tall with the scroll as moonlight breaks through the trees
a hundred Naruto clones filling the forest clearing

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He does not celebrate. He runs an experiment. One clone, the next page, and a long walk around a tree.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone reading the scroll while walking around a tree
Naruto waiting impatiently with arms crossed

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Pop me when I finish! I want to see if it works!

visuals.query: Naruto clone holding the scroll, grinning, eager

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Reading, reading. Ooh, this seal is nasty. Okay, I see how it works.

visuals.query: Naruto clone concentrating hard over the scroll

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto pokes him with a stick. Pop. And he knows the seal. Not read it. Knows it.

visuals.query: Naruto poking a clone with a stick, a poof of smoke
Naruto's eyes widening as the knowledge arrives

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Wait. I can be in two classes at once.

visuals.query: Naruto's slow wide grin

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I can be in all of them!

visuals.query: Naruto arms wide as a field of clones appears around him

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Naruto! There you are! Do you have any idea what you have done?

visuals.query: Iruka bursting into the forest clearing, sweating and furious

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki arrives smiling, and throws a storm of shuriken. Iruka shoves Naruto aside and takes every one in the back.

visuals.query: Mizuki throwing shuriken in the forest
Iruka with shuriken in his back, shielding Naruto

beats.speaker: MIZUKI
beats.text: Twelve years ago the Nine Tails destroyed this village. And you are the fox, Naruto. Everyone knew but you.

visuals.query: Mizuki sneering from a tree branch

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: He is not the demon fox. He is Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. And he is my student.

visuals.query: Iruka wounded and smiling with tears in his eyes, shuriken in his back

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki charges. Naruto answers with the one jutsu he learned tonight, and the clearing fills with a thousand of him.

visuals.query: a thousand Naruto clones filling the forest clearing
crowd of Naruto clones surrounding Mizuki

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Come on, Mizuki! Pick one! Pick any one!

visuals.query: Naruto clones surrounding a frightened Mizuki

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Mizuki goes down under a mountain of orange. Then the clones disperse, and a thousand memories come home at once.

visuals.query: Mizuki buried under a mass of Naruto clones
Naruto freezing as clones vanish in smoke all around him

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The same moment, from a thousand angles. Mizuki's fist. The moon. And Iruka's face, crying, a thousand times over. The first person who ever chose him.

visuals.query: Iruka's tearful face seen in the moonlight
Naruto looking up at the moon, overwhelmed

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He drops to his knees and throws up in the dirt. Iruka thinks it is chakra exhaustion.

visuals.query: Naruto on his knees in the dirt, shaking
Iruka looking down at Naruto with worry

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It is not the chakra, sensei. I just saw your face a thousand times.

visuals.query: Naruto looking up at Iruka through tears

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Close your eyes, Naruto. I have something for you.

visuals.query: Iruka smiling gently, headband in his hands

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.text: Congratulations. You graduate.

visuals.query: Iruka tying his own headband on Naruto's forehead
Naruto with the new headband, tears and a huge smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Everyone else remembers one graduation night. Naruto gets to remember it a thousand times.

visuals.query: Naruto and Iruka silhouetted against the first light of dawn
Naruto smiling in the early sunrise with his new headband

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Morning. He should be asleep. Instead he is on the Academy roof with twenty clones, testing the rules of the cheat code.

visuals.query: Naruto and a crowd of clones on the Academy rooftop at sunrise
crowd of clones sitting around making plans on the roof

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rule one. The knowing comes back. The muscles do not. Skill yes, strength no.

visuals.query: Naruto flexing a skinny arm, unimpressed
clone holding up a scrawny arm next to Naruto

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Okay, rule three. A clone that gets hit pops. So who is getting punched?

visuals.query: Naruto clone nervously raising a hand on the roof

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Not me. I got punched last time.

visuals.query: Naruto clone pointing at himself, offended

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: You are the same person!

visuals.query: two Naruto clones arguing face to face

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Then it does not matter who!

visuals.query: Naruto clones all pointing at one another

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Somebody gets punched. Pop. On the roof, Naruto winces for a face that is not his. Rule three, confirmed. He keeps the hit.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone being punched and poofing into smoke
Naruto wincing and rubbing his cheek

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rule two, the tiredness comes back too. Fifty clones for one hour is a fifty hour headache. He sleeps for nineteen hours.

visuals.query: fifty Naruto clones lined up across the training ground
Naruto collapsed face down on the training ground as clones vanish

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ugh. Why is there a crow on my chest?

visuals.query: groggy Naruto waking at dusk on the training ground, a crow perched on his chest

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Batches. Batches of ten.

visuals.query: Naruto sitting up and wiping his face, resolved

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Okay. Every class I ever slept through. Everything I missed. Go!

visuals.query: Naruto pointing the way as clones scatter across the Academy grounds
Naruto clones hidden in the back of an Academy classroom taking notes

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The library throws him out. He is that boy. So thirty clones walk back in, transformed into thirty different old men.

visuals.query: Naruto clones disguised as old men browsing library shelves
a row of old men in a library, one with whisker marks

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Good afternoon, sir. Where might I find the chakra control primer?

visuals.query: a Naruto clone disguised as an old man, whisker marks still visible

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: What a coincidence. I am also looking for that book.

visuals.query: another old man clone nodding beside the first at the shelf

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: One librarian notices that all thirty are reading the same beginner's chakra control primer.

visuals.query: a suspicious librarian peering at a row of identical old men
a beginner's chakra control book held up in a library

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then leaf balancing and tree walking, times two hundred. And he finally learns why his clones always failed.

visuals.query: clones balancing leaves on foreheads and climbing trees on the training ground
Naruto in realisation, eyes wide

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It was never too little chakra. It was way too much, poured through a pinhole!

visuals.query: Naruto laughing in disbelief

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Two hundred clones, ten hours each. That is two thousand hours of practice a day. Most genin do not train that much in a year.

visuals.query: two hundred Naruto clones practicing across the training ground, climbing trees
Naruto pumping a fist

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the Hokage's balcony, the Third Hokage watches all of it in his crystal ball, pipe in hand. He has watched the village this way for years.

visuals.query: the Third Hokage looking into his crystal ball, pipe in hand
a crystal ball showing Naruto on the training ground

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Two thousand hours a day. Hm. Well. That explains the librarian.

visuals.query: Hiruzen smiling slyly around his pipe

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He is not angry. He is looking at the paperwork on his own desk. Then at the crystal ball. Then at the paperwork.

visuals.query: Hiruzen looking from a huge pile of paperwork to the crystal ball
a towering stack of paperwork on the Hokage's desk

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The summons comes that evening. Naruto walks into the Hokage's office braced to be yelled at.

visuals.query: Naruto standing nervously before the Hokage's desk
the Hokage's office with the Hokage hat on the desk

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man, I can explain. Okay, I cannot. But the scroll was a great idea!

visuals.query: Naruto sweating, laughing awkwardly

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Stealing the Scroll of Seals is a crime, Naruto. The sentence is one month of filing duty, in my archive.

visuals.query: Hiruzen calmly regarding Naruto through pipe smoke

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Unclassified mission reports only. Every shelf, every box.

visuals.query: Hiruzen holding up a thick folder of mission reports

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Filing?! I'm a ninja now!

visuals.query: Naruto shouting, pointing at his headband

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Then file like one.

visuals.query: Hiruzen smiling with a faint glint

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A month? Old man, I could do a month in a day.

visuals.query: Naruto scoffing with arms crossed

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: I know. That is rather the point.

visuals.query: Hiruzen's eyes twinkling over his pipe

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His reasons are two. Keep the boy where the old man can see him. And give a lonely kid a building where he is finally allowed to be inside.

visuals.query: Hiruzen watching Naruto with a soft expression
Naruto alone in the village street, looking at the Hokage tower

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Day one. Two hundred Narutos enter the archive. It is, structurally, a fire hazard.

visuals.query: a flood of Naruto clones pouring into the cramped archive
Naruto clones squeezed between shelves of scrolls

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Pass it down! Pass it down! Do not drop it, it is older than us!

visuals.query: a human chain of Naruto clones passing scrolls hand to hand
scrolls and files passed along in a chain

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Why is there a stamp on your forehead?

visuals.query: a Naruto clone with a rubber stamp mark on his forehead
a rubber stamp hitting a document

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: He needed a flat surface!

visuals.query: a guilty Naruto clone holding a stamp

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By noon, a chain of clones runs scrolls from the basement to the third floor. By night, the Hokage's in tray is empty. For the first time in thirty years.

visuals.query: Hiruzen staring at his empty in tray
a clean empty desk with only a pipe on it

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: But a mission report is not a story. It is an after action report. Every ambush that worked. Every formation that failed.

visuals.query: Naruto reading a mission report with growing seriousness
the text of a report trailing off

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Most genin learn from one teacher. Naruto is learning from every shinobi who ever came home. And a few who did not.

visuals.query: rows of silent Naruto clones reading, lit by lamplight
Naruto reading, lamplight on his face

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. This one is signed by somebody who never came back.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone holding a report with a worn signature

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Read it anyway. Somebody should.

visuals.query: Naruto looking down, quiet and serious

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He goes quiet. For the first time in his life, Naruto Uzumaki is not the loudest person in the room.

visuals.query: Naruto silent among stacks of reports
clones sitting silently reading

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the sixth day, a clone in the back corner pulls out a thin folder. Kakashi Hatake. Jonin instructor evaluations.

visuals.query: a thin folder labeled Kakashi Hatake
a Naruto clone opening a thin file in the archive

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi has never passed a team. Every genin he ever tested went straight back to the Academy.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his orange book, one eye visible
Kakashi standing alone on the training ground

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Same reason, in the same lazy handwriting, every time. And tomorrow is team assignments. Naruto closes the folder with a prankster's grin.

visuals.query: Naruto closing the folder with a mischievous grin
Naruto's scheming smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Team Seven is announced. Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura. Their jonin instructor is Kakashi Hatake, and he is three hours late.

visuals.query: Team Seven, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura, waiting together
Kakashi strolling toward the training ground, book in hand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi Hatake is always late, and everyone in the village knows it.

visuals.query: Kakashi arriving late with a lazy wave

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto knew. It is in eleven separate reports. So he has had three hours to prepare the training ground, and he has not wasted one.

visuals.query: Naruto at the training ground secretly setting wires and traps at dawn
Naruto clones setting traps across the training ground

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Why are you standing in a ditch?

visuals.query: Sasuke staring down at Naruto standing in a ditch

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Listen, both of you. This is a teamwork test. He fails every team for the same reason. I know, because I filed the paperwork.

visuals.query: Naruto earnestly addressing Sasuke and Sakura
Naruto intense and serious

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: You are dead last. Why would I believe you?

visuals.query: Sasuke glaring with arms crossed

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto, nobody knows what the test is. Stop pretending you do.

visuals.query: Sakura scolding Naruto

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Knowing the answer is useless if nobody will listen. The real obstacle was never power. It is trust.

visuals.query: Naruto standing apart from Sasuke and Sakura, who look unconvinced
three genin standing apart in the training ground

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Then hear this. When he holds up the bells, you two take them. I will go back to the Academy. I only need two of us to pass.

visuals.query: Naruto earnest and steady, offering himself up
Naruto holding out two bells to his teammates

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Naruto. You would really do that?

visuals.query: Sakura looking at Naruto in surprise

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Hm. Fine. Stop talking and show me the plan.

visuals.query: Sasuke giving a small nod

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Three hours late, Kakashi strolls in, book open, and finds three genin waiting in a perfect triangle. He turns a page.

visuals.query: Kakashi reading his book while Team Seven waits ready
Kakashi's lazy visible eye above his mask and book

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Sorry I am late. I got lost on the road of life.

visuals.query: Kakashi with an eye smile, hand raised in a lazy wave

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Two bells, three of you. Whoever has none goes back to the Academy. Begin.

visuals.query: Kakashi dangling two bells from his waist

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke opens with a fireball, and Kakashi, for the first time, has to move.

visuals.query: Sasuke unleashing a huge fireball
Kakashi leaping away from the flames

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He lands on a wire Naruto strung at dawn. Sakura's kunai cuts it, and a log swings in.

visuals.query: Sakura throwing a kunai at a wire
Kakashi dodging a swinging log, book still in hand

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Not bad. Whoever planned that.

visuals.query: Kakashi lowering his book slightly, one eye widening

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Now, Naruto! Behind him!

visuals.query: Sakura shouting, kunai in hand

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken. Kakashi sidesteps it, bored. And the shuriken is Naruto.

visuals.query: Sasuke throwing a giant windmill shuriken
a windmill shuriken with Naruto's face

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto turning himself into a shuriken is canon. He just was not supposed to do it this early.

visuals.query: Naruto transformed into a windmill shuriken mid flight
Naruto reappearing grinning behind Kakashi

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: He does this to Zabuza in the Land of Waves.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A hand closes around a bell. Kakashi's one visible eye goes wide.

visuals.query: Naruto's hand closing around a bell
Kakashi's visible eye wide with shock

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Wait. Who taught you that?

visuals.query: Kakashi stunned, eye wide

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A lot of me.

visuals.query: Naruto grinning proudly with a bell in his hand

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: You pass. All three of you.

visuals.query: Team Seven together with Kakashi smiling behind his mask

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Already?

visuals.query: Sasuke raising an eyebrow

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: It is the first time I have ever said that. Do not ruin it.

visuals.query: Kakashi's eye curving into a smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That night he stands in the Hokage's office, and for once he does not open with a joke.

visuals.query: Kakashi standing in the Hokage's office at night
the dim Hokage's office at night

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Lord Third. What exactly have you let him read?

visuals.query: Kakashi serious, lamplight on his masked face

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.text: Only what the law allows. Why? Does he seem well read?

visuals.query: Hiruzen smiling slyly through pipe smoke

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Two in the morning. The archive is empty, except for one filing box that is not a filing box.

visuals.query: the dark empty archive at night with shelves of scrolls
a plain filing box sitting alone in the dark

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It is a clone Naruto left behind to finish the last shelf. Behind that shelf, a drawer sealed with a formula.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone transforming from a box and pulling out a drawer
a sealed archive drawer with a spiral seal

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: That is my seal. The one on my stomach. What is it doing on a drawer?

visuals.query: a Naruto clone staring at a spiral seal on a drawer

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Medical leave. Twelve years ago, October. Kushina Uzumaki. Approved by the Fourth Hokage.

visuals.query: a Naruto clone reading a medical leave form
a medical leave form bearing the name Kushina Uzumaki
the Fourth Hokage's signature on a form

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The clone pops. Across the village, Naruto sits bolt upright in bed, holding a memory he never lived.

visuals.query: Naruto bolting upright in bed in his dim apartment
Naruto wide eyed in the dark, breathing hard

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Uzumaki. Somebody had my name.

visuals.query: Naruto in bed, wide eyed, whispering

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Deep under the seal on his stomach, in the dark behind the bars, one enormous red eye opens.

visuals.query: the huge dark cage with the paper seal and a giant red eye opening behind the bars
Kurama's enormous slit red eye in the darkness

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: A thousand of you, brat, and every one carries a piece of me. Did you think I was not reading too?

visuals.query: Kurama grinning behind the bars, huge teeth

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In Part Two, a twelve year old asks the Third Hokage one question, and the old man has to decide whether to lie to a thousand witnesses.

visuals.query: Hiruzen and Naruto facing each other across the Hokage's desk
Naruto clones scattered across the village streets

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Old man. Who was Kushina Uzumaki?

visuals.query: Naruto looking up with a steady unwavering gaze
